|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Blow a kiss in the heart of the lava maze|Blow a kiss in the heart of the lava maze.]]''
''Equip [[black d'hide chaps]], a [[spotted cape]] and a [[rolling pin]].''
|{{plinkp|Black d'hide chaps}} {{plinkp|Spotted cape}} {{plinkp|Rolling pin}}
|Perform the emote at the centre of the [[Lava Maze]], next to entrance of the [[Lava Maze Dungeon]]. A [[Slash|slashing weapon]] or [[knife]] is required to navigate the maze.
|[[File:Emote clue - kiss lava maze.png|150px]]
|-
|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Bow on the ground floor of the Legends' Guild|Bow on the ground floor of the Legend's{{sic}} guild.]]'' 
''Equip [[Cape of Legends|Legend's{{sic}} cape]], a [[dragon battleaxe]] and an [[amulet of glory]].''
|{{plinkp|Cape of Legends}} {{plinkp|Dragon battleaxe}} {{plinkp|Amulet of glory(4)}}
|Players require completion of [[Legends' Quest]] to access the [[Legends' Guild]]. An [[amulet of glory]] with any amount of charges or an [[amulet of eternal glory]] will work.
|[[File:Emote clue - bow inside legends guild.png|150px]]
|-
|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Bow upstairs in the Edgeville Monastery|Bow upstairs in the Edgeville Monastery.]]''
''Equip a completed [[God book|prayer book]].''
|{{plinkp|God book|pic=Book of Balance}}
|Players require a [[Prayer]] level of 31 to enter the [[Edgeville Monastery]]. Any completed [[god book]] is usable for this clue.
|[[File:Emote clue - bow edgeville monastery.png|150px]]
|-
|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Bow within the temple in Civitas illa Fortis|Bow within the temple in Civitas illa Fortis.]]'' 
''Equip any piece of [[sunfire fanatic armour]].''
|{{plinkp|Sunfire fanatic helm}} {{plinkp|Sunfire fanatic cuirass}} {{plinkp|Sunfire fanatic chausses}}
|The temple is found near the southern entrance to [[Civitas illa Fortis]].
|[[File:Emote clue - bow fortis temple.png|150px]]
|-
|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Cheer in the Shadow dungeon|Cheer in the Shadow dungeon.]]''
''Equip a [[rune crossbow]], [[climbing boots]] and any [[mitre]].''
|{{plinkp|Rune crossbow}} {{plinkp|Climbing boots}} {{plinkp|Mitre|pic=Zamorak mitre}}
|Requires partial completion of [[Desert Treasure I]]. Bring a [[ring of visibility]] or a [[ring of shadows]]. The [[Rune crossbow (or)|ornamental rune crossbow]] also works. [[Climbing boots (g)]] do '''not''' work. The Egg priest mitre does '''not''' work.
|[[File:Emote clue - cheer shadow dungeon.png|150px]]
|-
|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Dance on the Fishing Platform|Dance on the Fishing Platform.]] ''
''Equip [[barrows gloves]], an [[amulet of glory]] and a [[dragon med helm]].''
|{{plinkp|Barrows gloves}} {{plinkp|Amulet of glory(4)}} {{plinkp|Dragon med helm}}
|[[Barrows gloves]] require full completion of [[Recipe for Disaster]] to equip. An [[amulet of glory]] with any amount of charges or an [[amulet of eternal glory]] will work.
|[[File:Emote clue - dance fish platform.png|150px]]
|-
|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Do the crab dance by the monument on Wintumber Island|Do the crab dance by the monument on Wintumber Island.]]''
''Equip a [[crab helmet]] and a [[crab claw]].''
|{{plinkp|Crab helmet}} {{plinkp|Crab claw}}
|Requires level 63 [[sailing]] to reach [[Wintumber Island]].
|[[File:Emote clue - crab dance Wintumber Island.png|150px]]

|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Headbang at the top of Slayer Tower|Headbang at the top of the Slayer Tower.]]''
''Equip a [[seercull]], a [[combat bracelet]], and [[helm of Neitiznot]].''
|{{plinkp|Seercull}} {{plinkp|Combat bracelet}} {{plinkp|Helm of Neitiznot}}
|Equipping the [[Helm of Neitiznot]] requires completion of [[The Fremennik Isles]]. If taking shortcuts to the top, it is advised to have a [[nosepeg]] or [[Slayer helmet]] in order to avoid stat draining from [[aberrant spectre]]s.
|[[File:Emote clue - headbang top of slayer tower.png|150px]]
|-
|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Headbang in the Fight Arena pub|Headbang in the Fight Arena pub.]] ''
''Equip a [[pirate bandana]], a [[Dragon necklace|dragonstone necklace]] and a [[magic longbow]].''
|{{plinkp|Pirate bandana|pic=Pirate bandana (brown)}} {{plinkp|Dragon necklace}} {{plinkp|Magic longbow}}
|Near Nightmare Zone. On the west side of the fight arena.
|[[File:Emote clue - headbang fight arena pub.png|150px]]

|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Jump for joy at the Neitiznot rune rock|Jump for joy at the Neitiznot rune rock.]]''
''Equip [[rune boots]], a [[proselyte hauberk]] and a [[dragonstone ring]].''
|{{plinkp|Rune boots}} {{plinkp|Proselyte hauberk}} {{plinkp|Dragonstone ring}}
|Players must complete [[Fremennik Isles]] in order to access the [[Neitiznot]] [[runite rock]]. [[The Slug Menace]] must be completed in order to equip the [[Proselyte hauberk|Prostelyte Hauberk]].
|[[File:Emote clue - jump neitiznot rocks.png|150px]]
|-
|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Jump for joy in the Ancient Cavern|Jump for joy in the Ancient Cavern.]]''
Equip a [[granite shield]], [[splitbark body]], and any [[rune heraldic helm]].
|{{plinkp|Granite shield}} {{plinkp|Splitbark body}} {{plinkp|Rune heraldic armour#Helm|pic=Rune helm (h1)}}
|Players need to have started the [[Barbarian Training]] [[miniquest]] in order to enter the caverns.
The [[rune heraldic helm]] is the rune helm from [[Treasure Trails]], not the [[painted heraldic armour]] from [[player-owned house]]s!
|[[File:Emote clue - jump ancient cavern.png|150px]]

|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Laugh by the fountain of heroes|Laugh by the fountain of heroes.]]''
''Equip [[splitbark legs]], [[dragon boots]] and a [[rune longsword]].''
|{{plinkp|Splitbark legs}} {{plinkp|Dragon boots}} {{plinkp|Rune longsword}}
|Completion of [[Heroes' Quest]] is required. The [[Dragon boots (g)|gilded dragon boots]], [[Dragon boots (cr)]], [[primordial boots]], [[Avernic treads (pr)]], [[Avernic treads (pr)(et)]], [[Avernic treads (pr)(pe)]], [[Avernic treads (max)]] also work.
|[[File:Emote clue - laugh fountain of heroes.png|150px]]

|{{plinkp|Castle wars bracelet}} {{plinkp|Dragonstone amulet}} {{plinkp|Ring of forging}}
|

|''[[Clue scroll (elite) - Panic at the area flowers meet snow|Panic at the area flowers meet snow.]]'' 
''Equip [[blue d'hide vambraces]], a [[dragon spear]] and a [[rune plateskirt]].''
|{{plinkp|Blue d'hide vambraces}} {{plinkp|Dragon spear}} {{plinkp|Rune plateskirt}}
|Panic by the [[Trollweiss]] flowers after [[sledding]] down [[Trollweiss Mountain]].
Make sure to bring a sled, otherwise you won't be able to complete the step. The poisoned dragon spear or rune plateskirt versions do not work.
